segments.text:
V. 44.
Jeſus ſaid with a loud voice—This which follows to the End of the Chapter, is with St. John the Epilogue of our LORD'S public Diſcourſes, and a Kind of Recapitulation of them. Believeth not on me—Not on me alone, but alſo on him that ſent me: Becauſe the Father hath ſent the Son, and becauſe He and the Father are one.
